thing-type.label: Mower
thing-type.description: Mower robot connected via robonect module

channel.label: Mower Name
channel.description: Name displayed for the mower in Robonect. Accepts a new name as a command.

channel.label: Mower ID
channel.description: Identifier reported by the mower.

channel.label: Mower Time
channel.description: Current date and time reported by the Robonect clock.

channel.label: Reboot Robonect
channel.description: Send ON to restart the Robonect module. The WLAN connection is interrupted during the restart.

channel.label: Shut Down Robonect
channel.description: Send ON to shut down the Robonect module.

channel.label: Put Robonect to Sleep
channel.description: Send ON to put the Robonect module into standby.

channel.label: Garage Door Enabled
channel.description: Whether the optional garage-door system is enabled.

channel.label: Garage Door Position
channel.description: Position of the optional garage door: 0% open, 100% closed, 75% opening, and 25% closing. UP opens, DOWN closes, and STOP releases the door.

channel.label: Garage Door Arrested
channel.description: Whether the optional garage-door system reports that the door is arrested.

channel.label: Mower Battery Level
channel.description: Battery charge level as a percentage.

channel.label: WLAN Signal Quality
channel.description: WLAN signal quality, converted to a scale from 0 (weakest) to 4 (strongest).

channel.label: WLAN Signal Strength
channel.description: Received WLAN signal strength in dBm.

channel.label: WLAN Enabled
channel.description: Whether Robonect is configured to connect to the WLAN.

channel.label: WLAN SSID
channel.description: Network name of the WLAN configured in Robonect.

channel.label: WLAN IP Address
channel.description: IP address of the Robonect WLAN interface.

channel.label: WLAN MAC Address
channel.description: MAC address of the Robonect WLAN interface.

channel.label: WLAN DHCP Client
channel.description: Whether the WLAN interface obtains its IP configuration through DHCP.

channel.label: Gateway Ping Monitoring
channel.description: Whether gateway connection monitoring is enabled. Robonect pings the gateway every 30 seconds and reconnects the WLAN after three consecutive missed replies.

channel.label: Gateway Ping Time
channel.description: Gateway ping response time as text, including the unit supplied by Robonect.

channel.label: WLAN Netmask
channel.description: Subnet mask of the Robonect WLAN interface.

channel.label: WLAN Gateway
channel.description: Gateway address used by the Robonect WLAN interface.

channel.label: Access Point Enabled
channel.description: Whether the Robonect access point is enabled.

channel.label: Access Point SSID
channel.description: Network name broadcast by the Robonect access point.

channel.label: Access Point MAC Address
channel.description: MAC address of the Robonect access-point interface.

channel.label: Access Point Hidden
channel.description: Whether the access-point network name is hidden from WLAN scans.

channel.label: Access Point Radio Channel
channel.description: Radio channel configured for the access point. The setting applies only while Robonect is not connected to a WLAN.

channel.label: Access Point Encryption
channel.description: Authentication and encryption mode reported for the access point.

channel.label: Access Point Client Limit
channel.description: Maximum number of clients allowed to connect to the access point.

channel.label: Access Point IP Address
channel.description: IP address of the Robonect access-point interface.

channel.label: Access Point Netmask
channel.description: Subnet mask of the Robonect access-point interface.

channel.label: Access Point Gateway
channel.description: Gateway address configured for the Robonect access-point interface.

channel.label: Access Point DHCP Server
channel.description: Whether the access point assigns IP addresses to connected clients through DHCP.

channel.label: Access Point DHCP Range Start
channel.description: First IP address in the access-point DHCP address pool.

channel.label: Access Point DHCP Range End
channel.description: Last IP address in the access-point DHCP address pool.

channel.label: Blade Motor Average
channel.description: Unscaled average diagnostic value reported for the blade motor.

channel.label: Blade Motor Speed
channel.description: Rotational speed of the blade motor.

channel.label: Blade Motor Current
channel.description: Electric current drawn by the blade motor.

channel.label: Total Running Time
channel.description: Total mower running time.

channel.label: Total Mowing Time
channel.description: Total time spent mowing.

channel.label: Total Charging-Station Search Time
channel.description: Total time spent searching for the charging station.

channel.label: Total Charging Time
channel.description: Total time spent charging.

channel.label: Full Charge Count
channel.description: Number of full battery charges.

channel.label: Recorded Error Count
channel.description: Number of errors recorded by the mower.

channel.label: Remote Portal Enabled
channel.description: Whether the mower.online remote-access service is enabled.

channel.label: Remote Portal Connected
channel.description: Whether Robonect is connected to the remote-access service.

channel.label: Remote Portal URL
channel.description: URL for remote access to the Robonect web interface; returned only while the remote service is connected.

channel.label: Remote Portal Host Name
channel.description: Host name reported for access through the remote-access service.

channel.label: Weather Mowing Pause
channel.description: Whether the weather service is currently preventing mowing.

channel.label: Weather Rain Intensity
channel.description: Current rain intensity reported by the weather service, as a percentage.

channel.label: Weather Temperature
channel.description: Current outdoor temperature reported by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Relative Humidity
channel.description: Current relative air humidity reported by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Daylight
channel.description: Whether the weather service currently reports daytime.

channel.label: Weather City
channel.description: City name resolved by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather City ID
channel.description: City identifier used to select the weather-service location. Accepts a non-negative integer.

channel.label: Weather Postal Code
channel.description: Postal code used to select the weather-service location. Sent as text to preserve leading zeroes.

channel.label: Weather Country
channel.description: Country returned for the weather-service location.

channel.label: Weather Sunrise
channel.description: Sunrise time returned by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Sunset
channel.description: Sunset time returned by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Icon URL
channel.description: Weather icon URL or URL template returned by the service, including any %s placeholder.

channel.label: Weather Observation Time
channel.description: Time of the weather data.

channel.label: Rain Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that rain prevents mowing.

channel.label: Cold Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that low temperature prevents mowing.

channel.label: Heat Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that high temperature prevents mowing.

channel.label: Dry-Air Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that low air humidity prevents mowing.

channel.label: Humid-Air Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports that high air humidity prevents mowing.

channel.label: Daytime Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports an active daytime mowing restriction.

channel.label: Nighttime Restriction Active
channel.description: Whether the weather service reports an active nighttime mowing restriction.

channel.label: Weather Pause Remaining
channel.description: Remaining waiting time before mowing may resume after a weather event.

channel.label: Weather Service: Enabled
channel.description: Enable or disable the weather service used by Robonect.

channel.label: Weather Service: Update Interval
channel.description: Interval at which Robonect requests new data from the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Rain Intensity
channel.description: Maximum rain intensity allowed before Robonect pauses mowing.

channel.label: Weather Config: Minimum Mowing Temperature
channel.description: Minimum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Mowing Temperature
channel.description: Maximum outdoor temperature allowed for mowing.

channel.label: Weather Config: Minimum Mowing Humidity
channel.description: Minimum relative air humidity allowed for mowing.

channel.label: Weather Config: Maximum Mowing Humidity
channel.description: Maximum relative air humidity allowed for mowing.

channel.label: Weather Config: Prevent Daytime Mowing
channel.description: Prevent mowing during daytime as determined by the weather service.

channel.label: Weather Config: Prevent Nighttime Mowing
channel.description: Prevent mowing during nighttime as determined by the weather service.

channel.label: Push Service URL
channel.description: Destination URL for Robonect push-service requests.

channel.label: Push Service Username
channel.description: Username used to authenticate push-service requests.

channel.label: Push Service Password
channel.description: Write-only password for push-service authentication. Accepts a new password as a command; its state remains undefined and automatic state prediction is disabled.

channel.label: Push Service Interval
channel.description: Interval for cyclic push-service requests.

channel.label: Mower Operating Hours
channel.description: Accumulated mower operating hours.

channel.label: Mower Mode
channel.description: Operating mode: AUTO follows the timers, HOME remains in the charging station, MANUAL prepares the mower for a separate lawn, and EOD returns home until the next day. Distinguishing EOD from HOME in state updates requires the localized Ajax web-interface request enabled by ajaxUiScraping.

channel.label: Mower Start Release
channel.description: ON releases automatic starts and requests a start; OFF blocks automatic starts and requests a stop. The actual mower activity is shown by Mower Status.

channel.label: Mower Status
channel.description: Current mower activity, such as parking, mowing, searching, or charging.

channel.label: Mowing Prevention Code
channel.description: Raw code identifying the condition preventing mowing.

channel.label: Mower at Charging Station
channel.description: Whether the mower reports that it is at home in the charging station.

channel.label: Current Status Duration
channel.description: Time spent in the current mower status.

channel.label: Current Remote-Start Distance
channel.description: Distance travelled from the charging station while travelling to a remote-start point.

channel.label: Mowing Schedule Status
channel.description: Current mowing schedule state: inactive, active, or standby.

channel.label: Next Scheduled Start
channel.description: Next start time reported by the mower schedule.

channel.label: Mowing Job
channel.description: Send ON to start a mowing job using this channel configuration, or OFF to stop it. Active job detection uses the localized Ajax web-interface response when ajaxUiScraping is enabled; otherwise it uses the binding's tracked job state.

channel.label: Offline Timeout Event
channel.description: Reports the configured offline timeout. The current handler publishes OFFLINE_TIMEOUT as a state update; it does not emit a channel-trigger event.

channel.label: Reset Mower Error
channel.description: Send ON to reset the mower's current error state. This is an action and does not report whether an error is present.

channel.label: Current Error Code
channel.description: Manufacturer-defined code of the mower's current error.

channel.label: Current Error Message
channel.description: Description of the mower's current error.

channel.label: Current Error Time
channel.description: Date and time of the mower's current error.

channel.label: Last Recorded Error Code
channel.description: Manufacturer-defined code of the latest error in the mower's error history.

channel.label: Last Recorded Error Message
channel.description: Description of the latest error in the mower's error history.

channel.label: Last Recorded Error Time
channel.description: Date and time of the latest error in the mower's error history.

channel.label: Robonect Internal Temperature
channel.description: Temperature measured inside the Robonect module.

channel.label: Robonect Internal Humidity
channel.description: Relative humidity measured inside the Robonect module.

channel.label: Blade Remaining Quality
channel.description: Remaining blade quality estimated by Robonect, as a percentage.

channel.label: Blade Age
channel.description: Number of days since the blade replacement date recorded in Robonect.

channel.label: Blade Operating Time
channel.description: Accumulated blade operating time since the last replacement recorded in Robonect.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: Host name or network address of the Robonect module

parameter.name: user
parameter.label: User
parameter.description: The user id if authentication has been enabled on the mower

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: The password if authentication has been enabled on the mower

parameter.name: pushUser
parameter.label: Push Callback Username
parameter.description: Username the mower sends to openHAB for push notifications. Both callback credentials are required to enable the endpoint.

parameter.name: pushPass
parameter.label: Push Callback Password
parameter.description: Password the mower sends to openHAB for push notifications. Both callback credentials are required to enable the endpoint.

parameter.name: pollInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: The interval for the binding to poll the mowers status information.

parameter.name: offlineTimeout
parameter.label: Offline Timeout
parameter.description: The maximum time the mower may be offline before the offline trigger is triggered.

parameter.name: timezone
parameter.label: Timezone
parameter.description: The timezone configured on the robot (e.g. Europe/Berlin).

parameter.name: detailedPollInterval
parameter.label: Detailed Polling Interval
parameter.description: The interval in seconds between detailed information polls, independent of the normal polling interval. Set to 0 to disable detailed polling. Also controls push-service mode polling when the unofficial API is enabled.

parameter.name: ajaxUiScraping
parameter.label: Ajax UI Scraping
parameter.description: Read additional job and end-of-day status from the localized Robonect web interface.

parameter.name: useUnofficialApi
parameter.label: Use Unofficial Web Interface API
parameter.description: Allow changing remote-start visibility, path, and corridor cut and expose the push-service mode through the unofficial Robonect web interface API.

channel-type.label: Battery Voltage
channel-type.description: Battery terminal voltage.

channel-type.label: Battery Current
channel-type.description: Signed battery current reported by the mower.

channel-type.label: Battery Temperature
channel-type.description: Battery temperature.

channel-type.label: Battery Capacity
channel-type.description: Full battery capacity reported by the mower.

channel-type.label: Battery Remaining Capacity
channel-type.description: Remaining battery capacity reported by the mower.

channel-type.label: Percentage
channel-type.description: Power level of the drive motor as a percentage.

channel-type.label: Drive Motor Speed
channel-type.description: Speed of the drive wheel.

channel-type.label: Drive Motor Current
channel-type.description: Electric current drawn by the motor.

channel-type.label: Recent Durations
channel-type.description: Recent operation durations as a comma-separated list of minutes, in the order returned by the mower.

channel-type.label: Remote Start Name
channel-type.description: Name of the remote-start point, limited to 16 characters.

channel-type.label: Remote Start Path
channel-type.description: Route followed to the remote-start point, using the path code reported by the mower. Commands require useUnofficialApi and a web-interface request.

channel-type.label: Remote Start Proportion
channel-type.description: Frequency with which the mower selects this remote-start point, as a percentage of starts.

channel-type.label: Remote Start Distance
channel-type.description: Distance from the charging station to the remote-start point along its selected route.

channel-type.label: Boundary Wire Sensor Label
channel-type.description: Position or description of the boundary-wire sensor reported by the mower.

channel-type.label: Boundary Wire Sensor Quality
channel-type.description: Signal quality of the boundary-wire sensor as a percentage.

channel-type.label: Boundary Wire Sensor Value
channel-type.description: Unscaled A, N, F, G1, or G2 loop-signal diagnostic value reported by the boundary-wire sensor.

channel-type.label: Timer Enabled
channel-type.description: Whether this timer allows mowing during its configured time window on its selected weekdays. Other mower restrictions and charging pauses still apply.

channel-type.label: Timer Time
channel-type.description: Start or end of the allowed mowing window. Only the time of day is meaningful.

channel-type.label: Timer Day
channel-type.description: Whether the timer applies on this weekday.

channel-type.label: Push Trigger Setting
channel-type.description: Whether Robonect sends a push-service request when entering or leaving this mower state.

channel-type.label: Battery ID
channel-type.description: Battery identifier reported by the mower.

channel-type.label: Battery Charge
channel-type.description: Battery charge level as a percentage.

channel-type.label: Job Time
channel-type.description: Start or end time of the active mowing job, read from the localized Ajax web-interface response only when ajaxUiScraping is enabled. Only the time of day is meaningful. Cleared when no job is active or the response cannot be read.

channel-type.label: Remote Start Visibility
channel-type.description: Whether the remote-start point is visible in the Robonect web interface. Commands require useUnofficialApi and save the setting through a web-interface request.

channel-type.label: Remote Start CorridorCut
channel-type.description: Whether CorridorCut is enabled for the remote-start point. Commands require useUnofficialApi and save the setting through a web-interface request.

channel-type.label: Extension Flash on Error
channel-type.description: Whether the extension is configured to flash when the mower reports an error. Read-only in this binding.

channel-type.label: Extension Active-Low Signal
channel-type.description: Whether the extension signal is configured as active-low. Read-only in this binding.

channel-type.label: Extension State
channel-type.description: Current on/off state reported for the extension. Read-only in this binding.

channel-type.label: Recent Duration Statistic
channel-type.description: Statistic calculated from the recent operation durations returned by the mower.
